cards.limitations: 证据仅来自作者在11个标普500 GICS行业上的65个月前向回测，未报告跨市场、跨资产类别或不同参数设定下的稳健性；粘性先验和置信边界的设定可能影响结论；回测结果不构成未来收益保证。
cards.summary: 原文指出，经典NCO虽能缓解协方差矩阵病态问题，但对称方差会惩罚上行收益分散，且无约束HMM存在状态频繁切换缺陷。作者据此构建非对称下行风险与粘性状态切换的嵌套聚类优化框架，并在11个GICS行业上做65个月样本外前向回测。回测结果显示，该框架相对Plain NCO和标普500在年化收益、回撤与Calmar比率上有改善，但证据仅来自单一历史区间和特定参数设定。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes Asym-Sticky-NCO, which replaces symmetric variance with downside semi-covariance and adds a sticky regime prior to a hidden Markov model to mitigate return drag and regime whipsaws in sector rotation.
cards.originalTitle: Mitigating Return Drag and Regime Whipsaws in Sector Rotation: An Asymmetric Downside-Aware Nested Clustered Optimization Framework
cards.description: 该研究提出Asym-Sticky-NCO框架，用下行半协方差替代对称方差，并在隐马尔可夫模型中引入粘性状态先验，以缓解行业轮动中的收益拖累和状态频繁切换问题。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work addresses two common structural weaknesses in machine-learning asset allocation—symmetric risk measurement and excessive regime switching—and offers a testable framework for reducing turnover and drawdown in sector rotation strategies.
keyPointsEn: Replaces symmetric covariance with the Bawa-Lindenberg downside semi-covariance in both hierarchical clustering and two-stage allocation.
Introduces a diagonal self-transition persistence prior and confidence-adaptive boundaries in a Gaussian HMM to limit regime switching.
In the 65-month out-of-sample backtest, regime switches fall from 16 to 4 and monthly turnover drops from 60.78% to 30.48%.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the authors' 65-month out-of-sample backtest on 11 S&P 500 GICS sectors; robustness across markets, asset classes, or parameter settings is not reported. The sticky prior and confidence-boundary choices may affect conclusions, and backtest results do not guarantee future returns.
keyPoints: 以Bawa-Lindenberg下行半协方差替代对称协方差，同时用于层次聚类与两阶段资产配置。
在Gaussian HMM中引入对角自转移持久性先验与置信自适应边界，约束状态切换频率。
65个月样本外回测中，状态切换次数由16降至4，月度换手率由60.78%降至30.48%。
cards.summaryEn: The source notes that classical NCO alleviates ill-conditioning of covariance matrices, but symmetric variance penalizes upside dispersion and unconstrained HMMs switch regimes too frequently. The authors build an asymmetric downside-risk nested clustered optimization framework with sticky regime dynamics and test it on 11 GICS sectors over 65 out-of-sample months. Backtest results show improvements in CAGR, drawdown, and Calmar ratio versus Plain NCO and the S&P 500, but the evidence is confined to one historical window and specific parameter choices.
cards.title: 非对称下行风险与粘性状态切换优化行业轮动框架
cards.titleEn: Asymmetric Downside-Aware Nested Clustered Optimization for Sector Rotation with Sticky Regime Dynamics
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作针对机器学习资产配置中两个常见结构缺陷——对称风险度量和状态模型过度切换——提出可组合的改进方案，为行业轮动策略降低换手与回撤提供了可检验的框架思路。

cards.limitations: 测试期仅为2026年1月至7月，样本期较短；仅覆盖标普500股票新闻；商业模型识别公司能力（62%-74%）提示身份掩盖未完全消除公司信息泄漏；未报告不同市场状态下的稳健性；策略存活结论依赖于特定成本假设和通缩夏普比率方法；结果可能不推广至其他资产类别或新闻源。
cards.summary: 研究用OLIVIA协议测试AI决策模型阅读标普500公司新闻对股票收益的预测能力。事实：微调模型在验证集IC为0.055和0.065，盲测期IC降至0.020（t=1.7）；商业模型IC与隔夜至开盘走势相关（0.074-0.077），但与开盘后走势无关；无预注册策略在成本和通缩夏普比率后存活。作者观点：市场已先于交易者定价新闻，模型无法区分过度/不足反应。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes OLIVIA, a protocol using point-in-time inputs, masked company identities, validation-only selection, a hash-frozen analysis plan, and a single logged unblinding to test LLM news predictability. New finding: the fine-tuned model's signal decays to insignificance in the blind test; commercial model signals align only with pre-open overnight moves; no strategy survives costs and deflated Sharpe ratio. The protocol offers a reproducible anti-leakage framework f
cards.originalTitle: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market
cards.description: 研究提出OLIVIA协议，通过掩盖公司身份、时间点输入、验证集选择、哈希冻结分析计划和盲测期锁定，系统检验LLM新闻读数的可预测性。新发现是：微调模型的信号在盲测期衰减至不显著，商业模型信号仅与隔夜开盘前走势对齐，且无策略在成本和通缩夏普比率后存活。该协议为量化研究提供了可复现的抗泄漏测试框架。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study provides a reproducible, rigorous testing pipeline showing that LLM news signals largely decay after removing leakage, and that markets price news by the open. For quantitative researchers, it cautions against overestimating LLM predictive power without blind tests and cost analysis; for strategy developers, commercial model signals aligning only with pre-open moves imply limited post-open actionability.
keyPointsEn: OLIVIA includes point-in-time inputs, masked company identities, validation-only selection, a hash-frozen analysis plan, and single blind-test unblinding to rule out look-ahead, memorization, and selection biases.
The fine-tuned model's validation ICs were 0.055 and 0.065; the blind-test IC fell to 0.020 (t=1.7), not significant.

Commercial model news readings correlated with overnight-to-open moves (IC 0.074-0.077) but not post-open moves; under masking, commercial models identified companies 62%-74% of the time vs a 28% baseline.
cards.limitationsEn: The test period spans only January to July 2026, a short window; coverage is limited to S&P 500 stock news; commercial models' company identification (62%-74%) suggests masking does not fully remove firm information leakage; robustness across market regimes is not reported; strategy survival conclusions depend on specific cost assumptions and the deflated Sharpe ratio method; results may not generalize to other asset classes or news sources.
keyPoints: OLIVIA协议包含时间点输入、公司身份掩盖、验证集选择、哈希冻结分析计划与单次盲测解锁，以排除前视、记忆和选择偏差。
微调模型验证期IC为0.055和0.065，盲测期IC降至0.020（t=1.7），信号不显著。
商业模型新闻读数与隔夜至开盘走势相关（IC 0.074-0.077），但与开盘后走势无关；公司身份掩盖下商业模型识别率达62%-74%（基线28%）。
cards.summaryEn: The study tests AI decision models reading S&P 500 news for return predictability under the OLIVIA protocol. Facts: the fine-tuned model had validation ICs of 0.055 and 0.065, falling to 0.020 (t=1.7) in the blinded test; commercial models' ICs aligned with overnight-to-open moves (0.074-0.077) but not post-open moves; no pre-registered strategy survived costs and deflated Sharpe ratio. Authors' view: the market prices news before traders can act, and no model distinguishes over- from under-reaction.
cards.title: 大语言模型新闻信号在盲测中失效：OLIVIA协议与市场效率
cards.titleEn: LLM News Signals Fail Blind Test: OLIVIA Protocol and Market Efficiency
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提供了一套可复现的严格测试流程，揭示LLM新闻预测信号在排除泄漏后大幅衰减，并表明市场在开盘时已消化新闻。对量化研究者而言，这提醒需在盲测和成本后评估信号，避免高估LLM预测能力；对策略开发者，商业模型信号仅与开盘前走势对齐，意味着交易者难以在开盘后利用该信息。

cards.limitations: 实验仅覆盖CSI 300和CSI 500两个中国股票池，未报告其他市场或资产类别上的表现；比较对象为受控的MCTS版本，未与更广泛的外部基线对比；图构建依赖表达式结构相似性和截面暴露相关性等度量，其稳健性未在文中充分讨论；因子挖掘结果不构成投资建议。
cards.summary: 现有LLM因子挖掘主要沿生成谱系组织搜索，忽略了不同分支间的结构相似性和统计相关性，可能限制探索范围。作者将因子表示为包含生成谱系、表达式结构相似性和截面暴露相关性的多关系图，并让搜索效用沿图传播，同时用帕累托选择权衡质量、繁殖力和多样性。在CSI 300和CSI 500上，CosmosAlpha-Graph在七项预测与组合指标上的平均排名最优，且每项报告指标均优于受控的MCTS版本。
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces CosmosAlpha, which organizes LLM-generated factors into a multi-relational graph and uses a graph flow mechanism with Pareto-guided selection to exploit structural and statistical relationships across search branches for factor mining.
cards.originalTitle: CosmosAlpha: Multi-Relational Graph Search with Pareto-Guided Exploration for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
cards.description: 该研究提出CosmosAlpha，用多关系图组织LLM生成的因子，并引入图流机制与帕累托引导选择，以利用跨分支的结构与统计关系提升因子挖掘效率。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work shows that in LLM-driven symbolic factor mining, structural and statistical relationships across branches can serve as search signals beyond generation lineage, offering an interpretable graph-based organization for multi-objective factor discovery.
keyPointsEn: CosmosAlpha organizes factors as a multi-relational graph encoding generation lineage, expression-structure similarity, and cross-sectional exposure correlation.
A graph flow mechanism lets each factor assess search utility using relational evidence from nearby factors rather than in isolation.
Pareto-guided selection explicitly models trade-offs among quality, fertility, and diversity to support multi-objective search.
On CSI 300 and CSI 500, CosmosAlpha-Graph achieves the best mean rank over seven metrics and outperforms the controlled CosmosAlpha-MCTS on every metric.
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments cover only two Chinese stock pools, CSI 300 and CSI 500, with no reported results on other markets or asset classes; comparisons are limited to a controlled MCTS version rather than broader external baselines; the robustness of graph construction based on expression-structure similarity and cross-sectional exposure correlation is not fully discussed; the factor mining results do not constitute investment advice.
keyPoints: CosmosAlpha将因子组织为多关系图，同时编码生成谱系、表达式结构相似性和截面暴露相关性。
图流机制让每个因子借助邻近因子的关系证据评估搜索效用，而非孤立判断。
帕累托引导选择显式建模质量、繁殖力和多样性之间的权衡，以支持多目标搜索。
在CSI 300和CSI 500上，CosmosAlpha-Graph在七项指标上平均排名最优，且每项指标均优于受控的CosmosAlpha-MCTS。
cards.summaryEn: Existing LLM-driven factor mining mainly organizes search along generation lineage, overlooking structural similarity and statistical correlation across branches, which may limit exploration. The authors represent factors as a multi-relational graph encoding generation lineage, expression-structure similarity, and cross-sectional exposure correlation, propagate search utility over the graph, and use Pareto-guided selection to trade off quality, fertility, and diversity. On CSI 300 and CSI 500, CosmosAlpha-Graph achieves the best mean rank over seven predictive and portfolio metrics and outperforms its controlled MCTS counterpart on every reported metric.
cards.title: 多关系图搜索与帕累托引导的LLM因子挖掘框架CosmosAlpha
cards.titleEn: CosmosAlpha: Multi-Relational Graph Search with Pareto-Guided Exploration for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明，在LLM驱动的符号因子挖掘中，除生成谱系外，跨分支的结构与统计关系也可作为搜索信号，为多目标因子发现提供了一种可解释的图组织方式。

cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：开发集仅24只股票，留出集为82只股票的冻结样本，结论限于该设定；Reverse方向失效与Follow翻转无效均为特定留出集上的观察，不能推广为一般性结论。双证书为理论性质，未在更广泛市场、资产类别或不同延迟结构下验证。作者自述贡献为安全自适应使用而非已证实alpha，故不应解读为投资建议或收益保证。
cards.summary: 作者提出一种组合控制器，在预测的经济方向、可靠性和时点均不可信时，于Safe、Follow、Reverse三类动作间选择，并以证据门控在方向证据不足时弃权至Safe。该架构提供跟踪切换动作序列的遗憾界与路径级抵押安全界，但在82只股票冻结留出集上，预设的Reverse方向未能跑赢等权，事后诊断翻转至Follow亦未恢复收益优势。作者明确贡献为不可信预测的安全自适应使用，而非已证实的alpha。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a portfolio control architecture for safely using machine predictions when their direction and reliability are unknown, adaptively learning signal orientation among Safe, Follow, and Reverse actions with an evidence-gated abstention mechanism, and providing dual certificates under delay and one-sided intervention. Its value lies in formalizing the boundaries of using untrusted predictions, not in claiming excess returns.
cards.originalTitle: Safe Portfolio Learning from Untrusted Predictions: Signed Trust, Abstention, and Cross-Universe Polarity Failure
cards.description: 该研究提出一种在预测方向与可靠性未知时安全使用机器学习预测的组合控制架构，通过Safe、Follow、Reverse三种动作与证据门控弃权机制自适应学习信号方向，并给出延迟与单边干预下的双证书。其价值在于将不可信预测的使用边界形式化，而非宣称获得超额收益。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Quantitative portfolios using machine predictions often face untrusted direction, delayed feedback, and overlapping multi-period positions. This work formalizes 'safe use of untrusted predictions' into verifiable controllers and certificates, and provides empirical boundaries of cross-universe polarity failure, helping practitioners distinguish safety constraints from return sources and avoid mistaking prediction assistance for alpha.
keyPointsEn: The controller selects among Safe, Follow, and Reverse portfolio actions, so signal orientation is learned rather than assumed; an evidence gate can abstain by transferring unsupported directional probability to Safe.

The architecture offers dual certificates: a tracking regret bound against switching action sequences under delay and one-sided intervention, and a pathwise collateral safety bound that holds when predictions fail.

On the frozen 82-stock holdout, the pre-specified Reverse orientation fails to outperform Equal Weight, and a post-hoc flip to Follow also does not recover a return edge; under the post-holdout controller, protected wealth remains within 15.9 basis points of the Safe benchmark throughout.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries are explicit: the development universe has only 24 stocks and the holdout is a frozen sample of 82 stocks, so conclusions are limited to this setting; the Reverse failure and the ineffectiveness of the Follow flip are observations on this specific holdout and should not be generalized. The dual certificates are theoretical properties not validated across broader markets, asset classes, or different delay structures. The authors state the contribution is safe adaptive use rather than demonstrated alpha, so it should not be read as investment advice or a return guarantee.
keyPoints: 控制器在Safe、Follow、Reverse三类组合动作间选择，使信号方向被学习而非预设；证据门控可将无支撑的方向概率转移至Safe实现弃权。
架构提供双证书：延迟与单边干预下相对切换动作序列的跟踪遗憾界，以及预测失效时仍成立的路径级抵押安全界。
在82只股票冻结留出集上，预设Reverse方向未跑赢等权，事后翻转至Follow亦未恢复收益优势；留出后控制器下受保护财富全程距Safe基准不超过15.9个基点。
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a portfolio controller that chooses among Safe, Follow, and Reverse actions when predictions' economic direction, reliability, and timing are untrusted, and abstains to Safe via an evidence gate when directional evidence is insufficient. The architecture provides a regret bound against switching action sequences and a pathwise collateral safety bound, yet on a frozen 82-stock holdout the pre-specified Reverse orientation fails to outperform Equal Weight, and a post-hoc flip to Follow also does not recover a return edge. The authors explicitly frame the contribution as safe adaptive use of untrusted predictions, not demonstrated alpha.
cards.title: 不可信预测下的安全组合学习：符号信任、弃权与跨域极性失效
cards.titleEn: Safe Portfolio Learning from Untrusted Predictions: Signed Trust, Abstention, and Cross-Universe Polarity Failure
cards.whyItMatters: 量化组合使用机器学习预测时，常面临方向不可信、反馈延迟与多期持仓重叠的问题。该工作将“安全使用不可信预测”形式化为可验证的控制器与证书，并给出跨域极性失效的实证边界，有助于从业者区分安全约束与收益来源，避免将预测辅助误认为alpha。

cards.limitations: 证据仅来自作者在特定机器人控制任务上的实验，未涉及其他领域或更广泛任务分布的验证；与单空间方法的比较基于有限基线，长期稳定性和泛化能力尚不明确；结论不应视为投资建议。
cards.summary: 预训练生成策略为机器人控制提供强行为先验，但用在线强化学习高效适应仍困难。作者提出CNDO，在噪声空间学习状态和噪声条件方向，并用软保守约束替代固定潜在可行域；进一步提出CANDO，加入动作空间残差。实验显示CANDO达到76.1 NAUC和91.4%最终成功率，分别超过最佳单空间结果6.6 NAUC和4.1%成功率。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes CANDO, which combines noise-space and action-space residual optimization to efficiently adapt frozen generative policies via online reinforcement learning, achieving better performance than single-space optimization in robot control tasks.
cards.originalTitle: CANDO: Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization for Residual Reinforcement Learning
cards.description: 该研究提出CANDO方法，通过结合噪声空间与动作空间的残差优化，在冻结生成策略上实现高效在线强化学习适应，在机器人控制任务中取得优于单一空间优化的性能。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method offers a new approach for online reinforcement learning adaptation of frozen generative policies without relying on fixed latent feasible regions, and improves sample efficiency and final performance by combining dual-space residuals, providing a reference for efficiently leveraging pretrained policies in robot control.
keyPointsEn: CNDO learns state- and noise-conditioned directions in noise space, regulating adaptation through conservative value estimation and gated execution without predefined latent feasible regions.
CANDO adds an action-space residual on top of CNDO, combining structured latent-space improvement with local action correction.
Experiments show CANDO achieves 76.1 NAUC and 91.4% final success rate in robot control tasks, outperforming single-space optimization methods.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the authors' experiments on specific robot control tasks, without validation in other domains or broader task distributions; comparisons with single-space methods are based on limited baselines, and long-term stability and generalization remain unclear; conclusions should not be taken as investment advice.
keyPoints: CNDO在噪声空间学习状态和噪声条件方向，用保守值估计和门控执行调节适应，无需预定义潜在可行域。
CANDO在CNDO基础上增加动作空间残差，结合结构化潜在空间改进与局部动作修正。
实验表明CANDO在机器人控制任务上达到76.1 NAUC和91.4%最终成功率，优于单空间优化方法。
cards.summaryEn: Pretrained generative policies provide strong behavior priors for robot control, but efficient online reinforcement learning adaptation remains difficult. The authors propose CNDO, which learns state- and noise-conditioned directions in noise space and replaces fixed latent feasible regions with a soft conservative constraint; CANDO further adds an action-space residual. Experiments show CANDO achieves 76.1 NAUC and 91.4% final success rate, surpassing the best single-space results by 6.6 NAUC and 4.1% success rate.
cards.title: CANDO：保守动作-噪声方向优化提升残差强化学习
cards.titleEn: CANDO: Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization for Residual Reinforcement Learning
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为冻结生成策略的在线强化学习适应提供了一种不依赖固定潜在可行域的新思路，并通过双空间残差结合提升了样本效率和最终性能，对机器人控制中高效利用预训练策略具有参考价值。

cards.limitations: 证据基于模拟与S&P 500 1995-2024样本，未覆盖其他市场或资产类别；预测方差虽能排序风险但整体压缩，可能影响依赖方差水平的应用；非线性改进的稳健性、样本外稳定性及交易成本以外的摩擦未充分讨论；模型估计依赖稀疏变分推断的近似质量。
cards.summary: 事实：PanelGP用高斯过程先验非参数估计载荷与因子的条件关系，并给出预测协方差与组合累积量的闭式表达；模拟中可恢复非线性映射与方差参数；S&P 500数据上非线性载荷的排序表现和组合夏普比率优于IPCA。作者观点：该模型能同时预测预期收益与协方差，且非线性载荷带来实证改进。需注意预测方差虽能排序风险但整体压缩，且结论基于特定样本与模拟设定。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes PanelGP, a conditional factor model that nonparametrically estimates how firm characteristics determine factor loadings and how economic conditions determine expected factors using Gaussian-process priors. Its novelty lies in nesting IPCA as a special case while allowing smooth nonlinear maps, and in jointly estimating loadings and factors via sparse variational inference to yield closed-form predictive covariance and portfolio cumulants. Usefulness: simula
cards.originalTitle: PanelGP: A Probabilistic Factor Model for Asset-Return Panels
cards.description: 该研究提出PanelGP，一种条件因子模型，利用高斯过程非参数化估计公司特征对因子载荷的影响以及经济条件对预期因子的影响。新意在于将IPCA嵌套为特例并允许光滑非线性映射，同时通过稀疏变分推断联合估计载荷与因子，得到预测协方差矩阵与组合累积量的闭式解。其有用性体现在：模拟中能恢复非线性映射；对S&P 500成分股1995-2024年的实证表明，非线性载荷比仿射载荷排序更优，组合夏普比率更高（含交易成本），最小方差组合波动更低。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a nonparametric factor-model framework that simultaneously outputs expected returns and a covariance matrix, with empirical evidence that nonlinear loadings outperform the linear IPCA specification in ranking and portfolio performance, relevant for risk modeling and portfolio construction.
keyPointsEn: PanelGP nests IPCA as a kernel special case and allows smooth nonlinear maps for loadings and factors.
Sparse variational inference jointly estimates loadings and factors, with closed-form predictive covariance and portfolio cumulants.
On S&P 500 1995-2024, nonlinear loadings rank better, portfolios have higher Sharpe ratios (net of costs), and minimum-variance volatility is lower.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on simulations and the S&P 500 1995-2024 sample, not other markets or asset classes; predicted variances rank risk but are compressed, which may affect applications relying on variance levels; robustness of nonlinear gains, out-of-sample stability, and frictions beyond trading costs are not fully addressed; estimation relies on the approximation quality of sparse variational inference.
keyPoints: PanelGP将IPCA嵌套为核选择特例，并允许载荷与因子关系为光滑非线性映射。
稀疏变分推断联合估计载荷与因子，预测协方差和组合累积量有闭式解。
S&P 500 1995-2024实证中，非线性载荷排序更优，组合夏普比率更高（含成本），最小方差组合波动更低。
cards.summaryEn: Facts: PanelGP uses Gaussian-process priors to nonparametrically estimate conditional relations of loadings and factors, provides closed-form predictive covariance and portfolio cumulants, recovers nonlinear maps and variance parameters in simulations, and on S&P 500 data shows nonlinear loadings improve ranking and portfolio Sharpe ratios relative to IPCA. Author view: the model jointly predicts expected returns and covariance, with empirical gains from nonlinear loadings. Caveats: predicted variances rank risk but are compressed, and conclusions are tied to the specific sample and simulation design.
cards.title: 面板高斯过程因子模型：非线性载荷提升股票收益预测与组合表现
cards.titleEn: Panel Gaussian Process Factor Model: Nonlinear Loadings Improve Return Prediction and Portfolio Performance
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化资产定价与组合管理提供了一种可同时输出预期收益和协方差矩阵的非参数因子模型框架，且实证显示非线性载荷在排序与组合表现上优于线性IPCA设定，对风险建模与组合构建有参考价值。

cards.limitations: 研究基于特定公开决策基准和两个金融语料，模型在现实标签问题上未展现超越基准率的能力，结果受限于所测试的模型家族和规模范围，未涉及其他金融任务或市场条件。
cards.summary: 研究训练了小型语言模型作为金融决策模型，在公开基准和两个金融语料上评估。窄领域微调导致通用决策能力下降9-45个百分点，但模型在现实标签问题上表现出与基准率一致的诚实不确定性。混合语料修复可在单一适配器中保留多项能力，并实现可部署的按领域温度调节。
cards.descriptionEn: The study trains small language models (0.8B to 32B parameters) for financial decisions, finding that narrow fine-tuning harms general decision competence, but models show honest calibrated uncertainty on reality-labeled questions, and mixed-corpus remediation balances multiple competencies.
cards.originalTitle: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation
cards.description: 该研究训练了0.8B至32B参数的小型语言模型，用于金融决策，发现窄领域微调会损害通用决策能力，但模型在现实标签问题上表现出诚实的校准不确定性，且混合语料修复能兼顾多项能力。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides fast, auditable and well-calibrated decision models for financial workflows, and the mixed-corpus remediation strategy helps balance specialized and general competencies in deployment.
keyPointsEn: Narrow fine-tuning reduces general decision competence by 9-45 percentage points, with the effect shrinking as model scale increases.
On reality-labeled questions, models from 0.8B to 32B reach the base-rate level (accuracy 0.37-0.38) with no detectable conditional edge.
Mixed-corpus remediation matches or slightly exceeds the specialist on the public benchmark while holding policy ceiling and near-specialist outcome calibration.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on a specific public decision benchmark and two finance corpora. Models show no edge beyond base rates on reality-labeled questions. Results are limited to the tested model families and scale range, and do not cover other financial tasks or market conditions.
keyPoints: 窄领域微调使通用决策能力下降9-45个百分点，该效应随模型规模增大而减小。
在现实标签问题上，0.8B至32B模型均达到基准率水平（准确率0.37-0.38），无显著条件优势。
混合语料修复在公共基准上匹配或略超专家模型，同时保持策略上限和接近专家的结果校准。
cards.summaryEn: Small language models were trained as financial decision models and evaluated on a public benchmark and two finance corpora. Narrow fine-tuning cost 9-45 percentage points of general decision competence, but models exhibited honest uncertainty tracking base rates on reality-labeled questions. Mixed-corpus remediation preserved multiple competencies in a single adapter with per-domain temperature regimes for deployment.
cards.title: 小模型在金融决策中的诚实不确定性与混合语料修复
cards.titleEn: Honest Uncertainty and Mixed-Corpus Remediation in Small Financial Decision Models
cards.whyItMatters: 为金融工作流提供快速、可审计且校准良好的决策模型，混合语料修复策略有助于在部署中平衡专业能力与通用能力。

cards.limitations: 论文主要建立数学框架与协议轮廓，未报告实际部署、链上性能或安全性测试数据；结论依赖连通性条件与供给/互换函数的形式假设；治理与求解器问责机制的有效性仅为设计目标，尚缺实证评估。
cards.summary: 论文将交易订单表示为连续单调的成对供给函数，将外部 AMM 表示为凹互换函数，在连通性条件下证明共同清算价格向量与外部互换的存在性，且各代币剩余非负。作者进一步证明均衡的结构性质（如个体净交易跨均衡不变），并将均衡计算转化为凸优化问题。基于此，论文勾勒了 Walraswap 协议，采用链下批量构建与链上结算，并设计治理与求解器问责机制以鼓励公开下单、抑制审查。
cards.descriptionEn: Building on prior Walrasian equilibrium exchange frameworks, this study incorporates liquidity from external automated market makers (AMMs), proves the existence of a common clearing-price vector and external swaps under a connectivity condition, establishes structural properties of equilibrium, formulates equilibrium computation as a convex optimization problem, and outlines Walraswap—an Ethereum protocol with off-chain batch construction and on-chain settlement.
cards.originalTitle: Walraswap: equilibrium-based decentralized exchange integrating external AMM liquidity
cards.description: 该研究在既有瓦尔拉斯均衡交易所框架上，引入外部自动做市商（AMM）流动性，证明在连通性条件下存在共同清算价格向量与外部互换，并给出均衡的结构性质与凸优化计算方法，进而提出链下批量构建、链上结算的以太坊协议 Walraswap。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides a Walrasian-equilibrium-based mathematical framework and a computable path for decentralized exchanges to integrate external AMM liquidity, and explores a protocol design that aims to reduce opportunities for maximal extractable value (MEV) through batch settlement.
keyPointsEn: Under a connectivity condition, there exists a common clearing-price vector and external swaps that simultaneously satisfy all orders while guaranteeing a nonnegative surplus for every token.
External AMMs execute ordinary swaps according to their own pricing rules (including fees); for the selected clearing-price vector, the external swaps maximize the value of the batch surplus.
Equilibrium exhibits structural properties such as invariance of individual net trades across equilibria, and equilibrium computation can be formulated as a convex optimization problem.
The Walraswap protocol uses off-chain batch construction and on-chain settlement, and introduces governance and solver accountability mechanisms.
cards.limitationsEn: The paper primarily establishes a mathematical framework and a protocol outline; it does not report actual deployment, on-chain performance, or security testing data. The conclusions rely on a connectivity condition and formal assumptions about supply/swap functions. The effectiveness of governance and solver accountability mechanisms remains a design goal without empirical evaluation.
keyPoints: 在连通性条件下，存在一组共同清算价格与外部互换，同时满足所有订单并保证每种代币的非负剩余。
外部 AMM 按其自身定价规则（含手续费）执行普通互换；在选定清算价格下，外部互换使批量剩余价值最大化。
均衡具有个体净交易跨均衡不变等结构性质，且均衡计算可表述为凸优化问题。
Walraswap 协议采用链下批量构建与链上结算，并引入治理与求解器问责机制。
cards.summaryEn: The paper represents trade orders as continuous monotonic pairwise supply functions and external AMMs as concave swap functions. Under a connectivity condition, it establishes the existence of a common clearing-price vector and external swaps that jointly fulfill prescribed orders while leaving a nonnegative surplus of every token. The author further proves structural properties of equilibrium, including invariance of individual net trades across equilibria, and formulates equilibrium computation as a convex optimization problem. Based on this, the paper outlines the Walraswap protocol with off-chain batch construction and on-chain settlement, along with governance and solver accountability mechanisms intended to encourage public order disclosure and discourage censorship.
cards.title: Walraswap：整合外部AMM流动性的均衡型去中心化交易所
cards.titleEn: Walraswap: An Equilibrium-Based Decentralized Exchange Integrating External AMM Liquidity
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为去中心化交易所整合外部 AMM 流动性提供了基于瓦尔拉斯均衡的数学框架与可计算路径，并探索了通过批量结算减少最大可提取价值（MEV）机会的协议设计。

cards.limitations: 证据来自arXiv预印本，尚未经同行评审；评估限于四个基准数据集，未涉及真实临床部署或前瞻性验证；小样本PTB队列仅显示竞争性泛化，未报告置信区间或统计显著性；概念探针与扰动分析为作者自述，需独立复现。
cards.summary: ECGJev将12导联心电图解读建模为对诊断问题的选项评分任务，利用预训练语言模型的决策解码器为每个选项返回概率。框架压缩冻结的波形和频谱特征为16个token，并通过两阶段训练仅用诊断标签适配桥接与低秩适配器。在CPSC2018、PTB-XL和Chapman上取得最高macro-F1，并在小样本PTB队列上展现竞争性泛化。
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces ECGJev, the first ECG framework built on a decision decoder, which compresses frozen waveform and spectrogram features into 16 ECG tokens via a question-conditioned bridge and adapts the decoder's native option readout in two stages to score all options for a diagnostic question in one forward pass. It achieves the highest macro-F1 on four ECG benchmarks, and concept probes and perturbation analyses show predictions rely directly on ECG input, remain stable under o
cards.originalTitle: ECGJev: Question-Conditioned Option Scoring for 12-Lead ECG Interpretation
cards.description: 提出首个基于决策解码器的心电图框架ECGJev，通过问题条件桥接冻结波形与频谱特征为16个ECG token，并采用两阶段流程适配解码器原生选项读出，实现对诊断问题的单次前向选项评分。在四个心电图基准上取得最高macro-F1，且概念探针与扰动分析显示预测依赖ECG输入、对选项顺序与措辞变化稳定，并可零样本迁移到未见波形概念。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This framework turns ECG interpretation into quantifiable option scoring, potentially improving automation and interpretability of clinical diagnostic question answering; concept probes and perturbation analyses indicate predictions rely directly on ECG input and are stable to option presentation, and zero-shot transfer suggests potential to adapt to new waveform concepts.
keyPointsEn: ECGJev is the first ECG framework built on a decision decoder, compressing frozen waveform and spectrogram features into 16 ECG tokens via a question-conditioned bridge.
A two-stage procedure adapts the bridge and low-rank adapters using diagnostic labels alone, scoring all options for a question in one forward pass on the decoder's native option readout.
Across four ECG benchmarks, ECGJev achieves the highest macro-F1 on CPSC2018 (80.46%), PTB-XL (71.68%), and Chapman (96.86%), and generalizes competitively to a small-sample PTB cohort.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from an arXiv preprint not yet peer-reviewed; evaluation is limited to four benchmark datasets without real-world clinical deployment or prospective validation; the small-sample PTB cohort shows only competitive generalization without confidence intervals or statistical significance; concept probes and perturbation analyses are author-reported and require independent replication.
keyPoints: ECGJev是首个基于决策解码器的心电图框架，通过问题条件桥接将冻结波形与频谱特征压缩为16个ECG token。
两阶段流程仅用诊断标签适配桥接与低秩适配器，在解码器原生选项读出上单次前向评分所有选项。
在四个心电图基准上，ECGJev在CPSC2018（80.46%）、PTB-XL（71.68%）和Chapman（96.86%）取得最高macro-F1，并在小样本PTB队列上泛化竞争。
cards.summaryEn: ECGJev formulates 12-lead ECG interpretation as option scoring for diagnostic questions, using a pretrained language model's decision decoder to return a probability for each option. The framework compresses frozen waveform and spectrogram features into 16 tokens and adapts the bridge and low-rank adapters with diagnostic labels alone in two stages. It achieves the highest macro-F1 on CPSC2018, PTB-XL, and Chapman, and generalizes competitively to a small-sample PTB cohort.
cards.title: ECGJev：基于问题条件选项评分的12导联心电图解读框架
cards.titleEn: ECGJev: Question-Conditioned Option Scoring Framework for 12-Lead ECG Interpretation
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将心电图解读转化为可量化的选项评分，可能提升临床诊断问题回答的自动化程度与可解释性；概念探针和扰动分析表明预测直接依赖ECG输入且对选项呈现方式稳定，零样本迁移能力提示其有潜力适应新波形概念。

cards.limitations: 证据仅来自比特币高频限价订单簿数据与 XGBoost 模型，PR-AUC 约 0.40 仍属中等水平；未说明跨市场、跨资产或跨时段的泛化能力，也未讨论交易成本、延迟等实盘约束，结论应视为特定实验设定下的观察。
cards.summary: 针对高频比特币限价订单簿数据中极端价格变动检测的困难，作者提出一种波动率感知的目标定义，将大额未来收益与高波动率状态同时纳入标签。使用 XGBoost 配合时间序列交叉验证和不平衡感知评估，该方法 PR-AUC 约 0.40，显著优于基线约 0.06。作者认为目标设计在金融机器学习中作用关键，常超过模型复杂度的影响。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes incorporating high-volatility regimes into the target definition to improve extreme price movement detection in high-frequency Bitcoin limit order book data, raising PR-AUC from about 0.06 in the baseline to about 0.40, suggesting target design may matter more than model complexity.
cards.originalTitle: Volatility-Aware Extreme Event Detection in High-Frequency Financial Markets
cards.description: 该研究提出将高波动率状态纳入目标定义，以改进高频比特币限价订单簿中的极端价格变动检测，相比仅基于大额未来收益的基线，PR-AUC 从约 0.06 提升至约 0.40，表明目标设计可能比模型复杂度更关键。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a volatility-structure-based target design for extreme event detection in high-frequency cryptocurrency markets, showing that redefining the learning objective can substantially improve rare event identification, with reference value for financial machine learning practice.
keyPointsEn: The extreme event target is extended to include both large future returns and high-volatility regimes, increasing the proportion of informative samples.
On Bitcoin high-frequency limit order book data, the XGBoost model achieves a PR-AUC of about 0.40 versus about 0.06 for the baseline.
The authors emphasize that target design may have a greater impact on rare event detection than model complexity.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to Bitcoin high-frequency limit order book data and the XGBoost model, and the PR-AUC of about 0.40 remains moderate; generalization across markets, assets, or time periods is not established, and practical constraints such as trading costs and latency are not discussed, so conclusions should be viewed as observations under a specific experimental setting.
keyPoints: 将极端事件目标扩展为同时包含大额未来收益和高波动率状态，增加信息样本比例。
在比特币高频限价订单簿数据上，XGBoost 模型取得约 0.40 的 PR-AUC，基线约 0.06。
作者强调目标设计对稀有事件检测的影响可能超过模型复杂度。
cards.summaryEn: Motivated by volatility clustering, the authors extend the target formulation to include both large future returns and high-volatility regimes for extreme event detection in high-frequency Bitcoin limit order book data. Using XGBoost with time-series cross-validation and imbalance-aware evaluation, the method achieves a PR-AUC of approximately 0.40, significantly outperforming the baseline of about 0.06. The authors argue that target design plays a critical role in financial machine learning, often exceeding the impact of model complexity.
cards.title: 波动率感知的极端事件检测：高频比特币市场新方法
cards.titleEn: Volatility-Aware Extreme Event Detection in High-Frequency Bitcoin Markets
cards.whyItMatters: 为高频加密货币市场中的极端事件检测提供了一种基于波动率结构的目标设计思路，说明重新定义学习目标可显著改善稀有事件识别，对金融机器学习实践有参考价值。

cards.limitations: 基准仅涵盖 102 个专家优化任务，来源限于开源项目，可能无法代表所有软件领域或优化类型；评估结果反映当前 LLM 在特定设置下的表现，不代表未来模型能力；性能测量虽噪声感知，但仍受环境与输入参数化范围影响，结论外推需谨慎。
cards.summary: SWE-Opt 是一个仓库级基准，源自 102 个开源项目的专家优化，针对运行时、峰值内存和时间加权内存使用进行噪声感知的参数化测试。评估显示当前 LLM 在优化任务上收益稀疏且不一致，内存优化几乎缺失；迭代探索的智能体设置能提升补丁正确性，但未转化为性能收益。专家实现平均加速 15.5 倍、峰值内存降低 171.3 倍，且在 93.1% 的任务中运行时提升、70.6% 的任务中峰值内存提升。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing code optimization benchmarks often focus on isolated functions or a single metric, ignoring trade-offs between runtime and memory, measurement noise, and input variability. SWE-Opt collects 102 expert optimizations from open-source projects and provides parameterized tests to evaluate runtime, peak memory, and TWMU under noise-aware conditions, revealing a substantial gap between LLMs and expert optimization.
cards.originalTitle: SWE-Opt: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Performance-Oriented Repository-Level Optimization
cards.description: 现有代码优化基准多聚焦孤立函数或单一指标，忽略执行时间与内存的权衡、测量噪声及输入变化。SWE-Opt 从开源项目收集 102 个专家优化，提供参数化测试，在噪声感知条件下评估运行时、峰值内存和 TWMU，揭示 LLM 与专家优化的显著差距。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark fills the gap in evaluating repository-level performance optimization, accounting for multi-metric trade-offs and measurement noise in real codebases, providing a more realistic yardstick for LLM capabilities on expert-level engineering tasks.
keyPointsEn: SWE-Opt contains 102 expert-written repository-level optimization tasks, each paired with parameterized tests covering runtime, peak memory, and TWMU.

Current LLMs show limited optimization ability: runtime gains are sparse and inconsistent, memory optimization is nearly absent; agentic iterative exploration improves patch correctness but not performance.
Expert implementations achieve an average 15.5x speedup and 171.3x peak memory reduction, with runtime and memory improvements in most tasks.
cards.limitationsEn: The benchmark covers only 102 expert optimization tasks from open-source projects and may not represent all software domains or optimization types; results reflect current LLM performance under specific settings and do not imply future model capabilities; despite noise-aware measurement, performance results remain influenced by environment and input parameterization scope, so generalization should be cautious.
keyPoints: SWE-Opt 包含 102 个专家编写的仓库级优化任务，每个任务配有参数化测试，覆盖运行时、峰值内存和 TWMU。
当前 LLM 在性能优化上表现有限：运行时收益稀疏且不一致，内存优化几乎不存在；智能体迭代探索提升补丁正确性但未带来性能提升。
专家实现平均加速 15.5 倍、峰值内存降低 171.3 倍，且在多数任务中实现运行时和内存改进。
cards.summaryEn: SWE-Opt is a repository-level benchmark derived from 102 expert-written optimizations in open-source projects, with parameterized tests for runtime, peak memory, and Time-Weighted Memory Usage under noise-aware measurement. Evaluation shows current LLMs achieve sparse and inconsistent runtime gains and nearly no memory optimization; an agentic setting with iterative exploration improves patch correctness but not performance. Expert implementations achieve an aggregate speedup of 15.5x and peak memory reduction of 171.3x, with improvements observed in 93.1% of tasks for runtime and 70.6% for peak memory.
cards.title: SWE-Opt：评估大模型仓库级性能优化的新基准
cards.titleEn: SWE-Opt: A New Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Repository-Level Performance Optimization
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准填补了仓库级性能优化评估的空白，考虑真实代码库中的多指标权衡与测量噪声，为衡量 LLM 在专家级工程任务上的能力提供更贴近现实的标尺。

cards.limitations: 输入仅包含项目自述与一句话简介，未提供基准测试、量化结果、与同类方法的对比数据或生产环境验证。因此对其检索效果和可解释性提升的幅度应保守看待，相关能力需以实际评测为准。
cards.summary: NVIDIA 的 Auto Ontology 是一个 Python 框架，用于在数据之上搭建语义化、基于图的推理层。项目声称可实现确定性的查询生成、更好的上下文检索，并为 LLM 与智能体工作流提供更可解释的 AI。上述能力来自项目自述，尚未在输入中给出独立评测或量化数据。
cards.descriptionEn: The framework's novelty lies in using semantic graph structures to provide deterministic query generation and context retrieval for LLM and agent workflows, aiming to improve explainability. Its value is in organizing reasoning as a traceable graph rather than relying solely on text prompts.
cards.description: 该框架的核心新意在于用语义图结构为 LLM 与智能体工作流构建确定性的查询生成和上下文检索层，从而提升可解释性。其价值在于把推理过程组织为可追溯的图结构，而非依赖纯文本提示。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the framework's claims hold, it could give agent systems more structured and traceable reasoning paths than plain text retrieval. This judgment rests only on the project description and has not been independently verified.
keyPointsEn: Positioned as a semantic graph reasoning layer for LLM and agent workflows
Emphasizes deterministic query generation and improved context retrieval
Uses explainability as a core differentiator
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the project's own description and a one-sentence summary, with no benchmarks, quantitative results, comparisons with similar methods, or production validation. Claims about retrieval and explainability gains should be treated cautiously and verified through actual evaluation.
keyPoints: 定位为面向 LLM 与智能体工作流的语义图推理层
强调确定性查询生成与上下文检索改进
以可解释性作为核心差异化目标
cards.summaryEn: NVIDIA's Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. The project claims deterministic query generation, improved context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows. These capabilities come from the project's own description; the input provides no independent evaluation or quantitative data.
cards.title: NVIDIA 推出本体框架为 LLM 提供可解释推理层
cards.titleEn: NVIDIA Auto Ontology Offers Explainable Reasoning Layer for LLMs
cards.whyItMatters: 如果框架的宣称成立，它可能为智能体系统提供比纯文本检索更结构化、更可追溯的推理路径；但这一判断目前仅基于项目描述，尚未有独立验证。

cards.limitations: 该内容为课程介绍，未提供具体实验数据、基准结果或可复现的量化证据；所提方法在真实场景中的有效性、LLM裁判的可靠性以及评估成本均未在原文中展开，证据边界限于课程大纲与作者观点。
cards.summary: 传统软件测试只能确认代码按预期运行，难以捕捉智能体决策与行动中的隐蔽失败。该课程主张从智能体轨迹中识别反复出现的失败模式，将其转化为可重复运行的测试集，并结合代码与LLM裁判进行自动化评估。事实层面，课程由DeepLearning.AI与Arize AI合作推出；观点层面，作者认为评估应成为智能体迭代的核心依据。
cards.descriptionEn: The course argues that traditional software tests cannot adequately validate agent behavior, and proposes reading execution traces to build rerunnable test sets, automating evaluation with code and LLM judges, and using evals to quantify whether each change truly improves the agent.
cards.originalTitle: Stop guessing how to fix your agent
cards.description: 该课程指出传统软件测试无法充分验证智能体行为，提出通过读取执行轨迹构建可复跑测试集，并借助代码与LLM裁判实现自动化评估，以量化每次改动是否真正改进智能体。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Agent failures often do not surface as explicit errors, so traditional tests can miss them. Systematic evaluation turns hidden failures into measurable signals, helping developers judge whether changes are effective and reducing blind trial and error.
keyPointsEn: Traditional tests are insufficient for catching failures in agent decisions and actions; dedicated evaluation is needed.
Reading agent traces helps identify recurring failures and build rerunnable test sets.
Code and LLM judges automate evaluation to verify whether each change improves the agent.
cards.limitationsEn: This is a course description and provides no experimental data, benchmark results, or reproducible quantitative evidence. The effectiveness of the proposed methods in real settings, the reliability of LLM judges, and evaluation costs are not elaborated; the evidence boundary is limited to the course outline and the authors' views.
keyPoints: 传统测试不足以发现智能体的决策与行动失败，需要专门的评估方法。
通过读取智能体轨迹识别反复失败，并构建可复跑的测试集。
利用代码与LLM裁判自动化评估，验证每次改动是否带来改进。
cards.summaryEn: Traditional software tests confirm that code works as expected but fail to catch subtle failures in agent decisions and actions. The course advocates identifying recurring failure patterns from agent traces, converting them into rerunnable test sets, and combining code-based checks with LLM judges for automated evaluation. Factually, the course is offered by DeepLearning.AI in partnership with Arize AI; the view that evaluation should anchor agent iteration reflects the authors' perspective.
cards.title: 智能体评估：用轨迹与评测替代猜测式修复
cards.titleEn: Agent Evaluation: Replacing Guesswork with Traces and Evals
cards.whyItMatters: 智能体失败往往不表现为显式报错，仅靠传统测试容易遗漏。系统化评估可将隐性失败转化为可度量信号，帮助开发者在迭代中判断改动是否真正有效，减少盲目试错。

Its relevance lies in offering a free alternative for local emulation, which may interest teams seeking to reduce cloud dependency costs.

cards.title: floci：面向云本地模拟的开源替代方案
cards.titleEn: floci: An Open-Source Alternative for Local Cloud Emulation
cards.whyItMatters: 本地模拟云服务可以支持离线开发和测试流程，减少对真实云账户的依赖；一个宣称免费且轻量的替代实现，可能为个人开发者和小团队提供更低门槛的选项，但目前仅凭仓库自我描述尚不足以判断实际适用性。

cards.limitations: 信息仅来自 GitHub Trending Daily 的项目简介，不包含基准测试、吞吐与延迟数据、模型规模与硬件配置，也没有与同类推理引擎的对比。分层流式加载的实际性能、冷专家读取带来的延迟、不同后端间的一致性均未经独立验证，不应据此推断其生产可用性或投资价值。
cards.summary: 该项目自述为面向前沿 MoE 模型的分层推理引擎：热专家驻留 GPU（支持 CUDA、Vulkan），温专家放在 RAM，冷专家从 NVMe 流式读取，使用 C 实现。按项目描述，其设计目标是在用户已有的硬件上运行模型。以上为项目说明中的主张，尚不构成独立验证的性能结论。
cards.descriptionEn: Colibri is a C-based hierarchical inference engine for MoE models that places hot, warm and cold experts on GPU, RAM and NVMe respectively, aiming to run frontier MoE models on existing hardware. Its novelty lies in substituting storage tiers for raw GPU memory, offering an engineering reference for memory-constrained setups.
cards.description: Colibri 是一个用 C 编写的 MoE 模型分层推理引擎，按“热、温、冷”三级把专家分别放在 GPU、内存和 NVMe 上，目标是让前沿 MoE 模型在现有硬件上运行。它的新意在于用存储层级划分替代单纯堆显存，为显存受限场景提供可参考的工程路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: MoE parameter counts often exceed single-machine GPU memory, and Colibri illustrates a tiered scheduling approach that trades storage hierarchy for GPU memory. For deployments with limited VRAM but larger RAM and NVMe, such a design offers a reference engineering direction.
keyPointsEn: Experts are placed in three tiers: GPU, RAM, and NVMe streaming
GPU backend covers both CUDA and Vulkan paths
Written in C, positioned for MoE inference on existing hardware
cards.limitationsEn: Information comes only from the GitHub Trending Daily project blurb, with no benchmarks, throughput or latency data, model sizes, hardware configurations, or comparisons with similar inference engines. Actual performance of tiered streaming, latency from cold-expert reads, and consistency across backends are unverified, so it should not be taken as evidence of production readiness or investment value.
keyPoints: 专家按热度分三级放置：GPU、RAM、NVMe 流式读取
GPU 后端同时涉及 CUDA 与 Vulkan 两条路径
使用 C 编写，定位为在现有硬件上运行 MoE 推理
cards.summaryEn: The project describes itself as a hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts reside on GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, and cold ones are streamed from NVMe, implemented in C. Per the project description, the design goal is running models on hardware users already own. These are project claims, not independently verified performance conclusions.
cards.title: 分层推理引擎Colibri按热度调度MoE专家
cards.titleEn: Colibri Hierarchical Inference Engine Schedules MoE Experts by Heat
cards.whyItMatters: MoE 模型的参数规模常超出单机显存，Colibri 展示了一种以存储层级换取显存空间的分层调度思路。对显存有限但拥有较大内存和 NVMe 的部署环境，这类方案提供了可参考的工程方向。
